title: Camps C6 / C20 — the three delete boxes switch to the shared ConfirmBox
subtitle: Rule v1.008 / v1.103 (approved M2). Delete camp, Delete template and Delete camper permanently stop using Color Belt’s ConfirmDeleteDialog and use components/ConfirmBox.jsx with loses: 'forGood'. The words don’t change (Keep camp · Delete camp, Keep template · Delete template, Keep camper · Delete permanently). What changes: while it works the red button says “Deleting…” and grays, and “Keep …” grays too (today nothing on screen changes); the buttons stack, each full width, when they don’t fit side by side (today the labels squeeze onto two lines); and the box never takes the pinned button row (today a screen under 700px tall gives it one, with a line across). Esc, a click outside and Back wait while it works (not visible in a picture). Admin. Amber = what changes.

320 wide: “Keep camper” and “Delete permanently” squeeze onto two lines each.

footer: The After pictures are the real Camps boxes in the preview with the shared ConfirmBox’s own markup and classes swapped in (cfm-actions, is-unavailable, the hidden sizer that measures the stacking), copied from parts.html#M2/busy, so the app’s real shared.css draws them. “Today, while it works” is a real screenshot taken with the preview’s save slowed down. A failed delete keeps today’s amber note under the buttons (“Couldn’t delete…”). Script: mock-c20-confirm.js. Compare dialog: picture 10b.
